title: On bass orders in division algebras
summary: A result by F.-T. Tu dating from 2011 states that the orders in a local matrix algebra of dimension four that can be written as a finite intersection of maximal orders are those having an Eichler Gorenstein closure. In a more recent paper, we gave a similar characterization for orders with a Bass Gorenstein closure. More precisely, we prove that these orders are the ones that can be written as a ghost intersection, i.e., the set of points defined over the base field of an intersection of maximal orders that is defined over a field extension.
